text:
Sam: Heads-up — Nimbus (Enterprise) flagged by health watcher. Usage down ~62% last 7d, seats inactive, renewal in 24 days. Starting a micro-save flow.
Maria: Can you paste the quick health snapshot? Ill run enablement pairing.
cs-bot: Account snapshot: last_active: 2026-03-12, weekly_api_calls: 38k (was 100k), top_feature: streaming-inference, alerts: low-engagement, renewal_date: 2026-04-05.
Sam: Console notes: `last_successful_onboard_step: model-pinning`, `avg_response_time_users: +20%`, `recent_errors: cache-miss-rate spike`.
AJ: Have they contacted support recently? I see one ticket about aliasing resolved two weeks ago.
Maria: Proposed micro-save cadence: Day 0: outreach + 15-min scoping call. Day 2: enablement pairing (45m) with SE. Day 4: apply 1-week reserved-capacity credits on commit. Day 7: checkback; if no engagement, offer phased downgrade with data-preserving export.
Liam: Add rollback SLA and migration checklist. AE needs a commercial summary.
Sam: Draft outreach email: `Hi Team Nimbus — we noticed a drop in usage before your Apr 5 renewal. Can we schedule a 15-min sync to review obstacles and run a short enablement session? We can offer temporary credits and a clear migration plan if needed. Best, Sam`
Maria: Add one-click calendar link and agenda: 1) health summary, 2) pain points, 3) next steps.
AJ: I'll export support logs and note infra maintenance 3/10 that may have affected batch jobs.
cs-bot: Playbook: micro-save-v2 (actions: outreach, enablement-pairing, credits-apply, downgrade-offer).
Sam: Assignments: Maria -> pairing session (SE: Liam), AJ -> support log + infra context, Sam -> outreach + AE sync, Liam -> migration checklist + rollback SLA.
Maria: Enablement goal: reproduce integration trace, confirm KV cache behavior, suggest prefix caching. If we show ~20% latency improvement in-session they often re-engage.
Liam: Prep demo checklist: reproduce failing flow, enable prefix caching snippet, share quantization tradeoffs, export path for model checkpoints. Snippet: `cache.prefetch(prefix, max_age=3600)
if cache.hit(): reuse.kv_cache()
else: continue.normal()`
Maria: If they decline session, escalate to AE and lead with usage-based credit rather than blanket discount. Keep renewal positive.
Sam: Timeline: sending outreach now. If no slot by Day 2, auto-nudge via in-product modal + email; Day 4 apply credits proactively.
AJ: Adding resolved ticket thread + infra notes to play notes.
Maria: Post-session success criteria: 1) commit to 2-week pilot (API calls), OR 2) AE-approved downgrade with migration dates. Else escalate to manager review.
Sam: Logging this as Nimbus micro-save flow. I'll paste call notes and recording into CS playbook after session.
Liam: Also prepare a one-pager for their CTO showing unit economics: before vs after optimizations (batching, cache, quantization) — helps procurement.
Maria: Marking status `in-progress` in CS tracker. Will update after pairing. :thumbsup:
